changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6687-chatbot-surface-authorable.md`

- names `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` → `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx`'s `Properties` table listed `surface` (`'card' | 'plain'`, "bordered panel or a frameless full-page workspace"), but the key had **zero read points**: none of the three `ComponentRegistry.register('chatbot*', ...)` sites in `renderer.tsx` forwarded it, and `ChatbotSchema` did not declare it. `surface` was real only as a prop of the React component — `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` defines `ChatbotSurface`, defaults it to `'card'`, and branches six layout decisions off `isPlainSurface` — so it was reachable by a hand-written React host and by nobody writing metadata. An author who wrote `surface: 'plain'` got the `'card'` default, with no error and no signal.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `328abeb55` (merge-base with origin/main): 2 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1690 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2290 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36418415810)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f9140e6c9e942ab17daaffeb83c1622f7e7e8d65`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card objectui#10965 (body and its 2 comments: claim 5869037584, os-dev-report 5869358487); PR #10968 body, file list and `git diff origin/main...refs/review/pr-10968` (merge-base `b120b66`; `origin/main` is now `328abeb`, one commit ahead, `.changeset/10900-zh-cn-leftovers.md` only, no overlap with the touched files; `7d82957b18` is an ancestor of the head); sibling PR #10952 (body) and its contract review `5868396957`; `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/` at objectui `origin/main` (`ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, `mapMessages.ts`, `useObjectChat.ts`); the 43 check-runs on the head, read last at 2026-09-28T12:07Z. Line numbers below are at objectui `origin/main` unless a file is named otherwise; `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` there is byte-identical to the hunk's base context.

### ① Derived judgments

The diff: `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` +8/-2 in one hunk (a four-line comment, `disabled={planActionsLocked}` plus `disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50` on `proposed-changes-confirm` and `proposed-changes-adjust`), one new test file with four cases, one `patch` changeset. Three files, 328/2. Nothing else.

1. **Gate signal: the same one objectui#10925 uses — right.** The hunk reads `planActionsLocked`, declared once at L2137 as `const planActionsLocked = isLoading;` by the sibling fix; the diff declares no const, prop, state or hook. `isLoading` is `status === 'submitted' || status === 'streaming'` (`useObjectChat.ts` L999), which is acceptance 1's definition of "in flight" verbatim, and it falls at `ready` (acceptance 2). The card forbade a new signal; none was added. The `submitted` window is covered only because the gate is not the per-message flag: `uiMessagesToChatMessages` sets `streaming` as `isStreaming && idx === lastIdx && role === 'assistant'` (`mapMessages.ts` L998-999), so while a request is out with no reply nothing carries it; pin case 3 asserts `messages.some((m) => m.streaming)` is false there and both buttons disabled.
   - **Cost, the sibling's:** an older confirm card is also held while a newer turn is in flight. Bounded the same way: in that window the textarea is `disabled={disabled || promptStatus === 'streaming'}` (L3432, with `promptStatus = isLoading ? 'streaming' : 'ready'` at L1454) and the send button is a stop button (L3479-3483). The confirm card now behaves exactly as the plan card does since `7d82957b18`, not stricter.
   - **Adjust:** `handlePlanAdjust` (L1896-1902) focuses the composer textarea and sends nothing; that textarea is disabled in the same window, so gating Adjust removes a no-op, not a capability. The card's Direction names both buttons, and objectui#10925 gated both of its Adjust buttons (L2736, L2809). Right.

2. **Sender coverage on this card — complete.** `onSendMessage` call sites at `main`: `handleSubmit` L1804 (composer, held), `handleSuggestionClick` L1816 (empty state only), `handlePlanApprove` L1852 and the chips L2675 (plan card, gated by objectui#10925), `handleChangesConfirm` L1888 (this card, gated by this diff). The confirm card's only other controls are `proposed-changes-publish` (L2904, `handlePublishDrafts` → `onPublishDrafts`, publishes a draft package) and `proposed-changes-quota-upgrade` (L4484, `onUpgrade`); neither sends a turn. After this diff every card-originated sender in the component sits behind `planActionsLocked`.

3. **Untouched branches — right.** The card's IIFE (L2851-2996) returns, in order: replay `published` (L2858), `failed` (L2871), `drafted` (L2889), quota-blocked (`quotaBlockedChanges.has`, L2920), `applying` (`outcome?.kind === 'applying' || confirmPendingIds.has`, L2937-2939), the no-`onSendMessage` hint (L2952), the legacy `confirmedChangeIds` collapse (L2959), and only then the default buttons (L2975). The hunk begins at that default `return (` (base context L2972-2975), so the seven earlier returns are untouched, and the `applying`, quota-blocked, `confirmed` and no-`onSendMessage` renders are unchanged, as are the three replay verdicts. `handleChangesConfirm` is untouched: it sets `confirmPendingIds` then calls `onSendMessage?.(changesConfirmMessage)` synchronously (L1876-1892); a disabled button fires no React `onClick`, so neither the send nor the optimistic Applying flip happens (case 1 asserts both). `planActionsLocked` is a plain const, so hook order is unchanged; hosts passing no `isLoading` keep the default `false` (L1366) and today's behaviour.

4. **Acceptance 3 — pinned through the real mapper.** `ChatbotEnhanced.changesActionsWaitForTurn-10965.test.tsx`: `chatProps` builds `uiMessagesToChatMessages(wire, { isStreaming: isLoading })` with `isLoading = submitted | streaming`, the call `useObjectChat` makes at L1015 and the same helper the objectui#10925 pin defines. Case 1: `streaming` → both disabled, a click sends nothing and shows no Applying. Case 2: `streaming` then `ready` → both enabled, Confirm sends `changesConfirmMessage` once. Case 3: an older card under `submitted` then `streaming` → disabled; `ready` → enabled. Case 4: `applying` reached optimistically and from a `replay_` re-dispatch at `input-available` on the streaming tail; quota-blocked after a `notSent` 429 `AI_DESIGN_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED`, still parked with its reason while a later turn is `submitted`; legacy `confirmed` from a later same-tool `{ success: true }` on the streaming turn (which `confirmedChangeIds`, L2041-2062, marks); the read-only hint with no `onSendMessage` — each with a turn in flight, each asserting its badge and no action buttons. Every `toBeDisabled` in cases 1-3 fails at `main`, where the buttons carry no `disabled`; the dev's per-button ablation (Confirm 3/1, Adjust 2/2) is consistent with the case layout and not re-run here. The `Test (shard n/8)` and `Type Check` check-runs are the gate verdict for this file; their state is in ③.

5. **Shipped prose, sentence by sentence.**
   Changeset `.changeset/10965-changes-card-wait-stream.md`:
   - "renders as soon as a tool such as `update_metadata` returns `changes_proposed`" — true; `detectProposedChanges` keys on `status === 'changes_proposed'` in any tool's result envelope (`mapMessages.ts` L439-441, called for every tool part at L771), not on a tool name, so "such as" is the right hedge.
   - "the turn that proposed the change keeps streaming after that" — the card's premise, shared with objectui#10925; the cloud loop storing each remaining step inside `streamChatWithTools` was verified in review `5868396957` ①.5 against cloud `origin/main`; cloud source is outside this review's inputs, so it is taken from that record.
   - "Confirm and Adjust were live the whole time, and Confirm sends its confirmation straight away" — true at `main`: no `disabled` at L2977-2993, and `handleChangesConfirm` reaches `onSendMessage` synchronously (L1888), no await, no timer.
   - "so a click in that window sent the next turn while the previous one was still in flight" — follows from the two above; the sibling's E2E showed the same overlap on the plan card.
   - "The proposed-plan card's actions were fixed for the same overlap" — `7d82957b18`, L2676, L2726, L2736, L2799, L2809.
   - "now disabled while `isLoading` is true, the signal the proposed-plan card's actions already wait on" — the diff and L2137.
   - "carry the native `disabled` attribute while they wait and come back once no turn is in flight" — true.
   - "Because the signal is not tied to the card's own message, the gate also holds an older card while a newer turn is in flight below it, including a request that is out with no reply yet" — true from `mapMessages.ts` L998-999 and `useObjectChat.ts` L999; case 3 pins both windows.
   - "Only those two buttons change" — true; nothing else in the file moves.
   - "The card's other states render as before: the Applying badge, the blocked state after an AI quota refusal, the Confirmed badge, and the reply hint shown when the host passes no `onSendMessage`" — true (①.3); the three replay verdicts are also unchanged and simply not listed.
   New source comment at the hunk: "`update_metadata` returns `changes_proposed` mid-turn, so this card renders while the proposing turn is still streaming and being stored" — the same premise as above; "Its actions wait on the same `planActionsLocked` the plan card uses (objectui#10925)" — the diff.
   PR body claims read against the source: "the `applying` ..., quota-blocked (objectui#7253), legacy `confirmed` and no-`onSendMessage` hint branches all `return` before that branch" — true. "Renaming it would edit the plan-card lines, and those fall outside the claim's declared file surface" — true: the const (L2137) and its five plan-card readers are outside "only the proposed-changes card's `proposed-changes-confirm` and `proposed-changes-adjust` buttons". "Adjust on this card only focuses the composer and sends nothing" — L1896-1902.
   Two pieces of existing prose the diff leaves narrower than the code, not false: the `planActionsLocked` comment block (L2120-2136) and the `isLoading` JSDoc (L468-471) still name only the plan card. Both sit outside the claim's surface, and the new comment at the hunk points back to the plan card, so a reader arrives at both from either side.

6. **File surface and premise.** The claim's surface (`ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, the two buttons reusing `planActionsLocked`; one test under `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/`; one `.changeset/10965-*.md`; ⛔ not `AiChatPage.tsx`) is held exactly. The branch is one commit on `b120b66`, which descends from `7d82957b18`; no commit between the merge-base and `origin/main` touches `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, `mapMessages.ts` or `useObjectChat.ts`. The commit carries `Claude-Session` and `Co-authored-by: Claude` trailers, the model-free pair the dev report names.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/10965-changes-card-wait-stream.md` declares `'@object-ui/plugin-chatbot': patch`. The diff publishes no new or removed export, prop, type or accept set; no JSDoc changes; the behaviour change is the fix itself (two buttons disabled during an in-flight turn where they were live). Patch matches what the diff publishes. The newest claim on the card (5869037584) says `Clause-②: no`; the PR body says `Clause-②: no`; the dev report says it stays no. Consistent. Check-runs `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`, `Changeset Claim Re-read`, `Changeset Overwrite Report`: success.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: `[]`. None to answer.
- Dev flag, `planActionsLocked` not renamed: judged right in ①.5. The gate is the same const, so no behaviour hinges on its name, and a rename would cross the claim's surface. The const's own comment now under-describes what it holds; that is a follow-up a later edit of those lines may pick up, not a defect of this diff.
- Dev flag, Adjust gated although it sends nothing: right (①.1); the Direction names both buttons and the sibling gated both of its Adjusts.
- Dev flag, no README or guide edit: the dev states the README does not describe this card. `packages/plugin-chatbot/README.md` is outside this review's inputs (`src/` only), so the statement is accepted as stated; the sibling shipped the same three-file shape under the same rule, and `README Export Check` on the head is success.
